scope: Only the two completed own-source PR784 attempt1 jobs: bench runtime/protocol and browser-engine bridge. Forty-two named runtime controls plus actual 8105 protocol checks over 113 lessons; source/API/log associated to exact candidate and synthetic merge.
limits: Other core-compilation, demo-browser and standalone IPhreeqc jobs are unreviewed and unaccepted by this receipt, regardless of their later completion. Whole run was not completed in the captured API snapshot.

Bridge controls check absent-solver refusal, live solution, desktop/browser pH difference below 1e-6 and ionic-strength difference below 1e-9, species transport, schema1 and five live R1 scenarios; this is implementation agreement rather than general empirical chemical accuracy.
Bench includes supported headspace/thermal/boundary behavior, cache-only scenarios and language/protocol controls; no universal chemistry or universal YAML conformance claim.
Ordinary hosted Cargo.lock and actual built binary bytes are uncaptured. No local or own-fleet lock/binary substituted for those uncaptured ordinary-job artifacts.

Cache/toolchain/build qualifications remain visible in raw own job logs. This reviewer executes no Cargo/CLI/WASM/browser code and makes no repaired-source standalone CLI12/CLI15 or integration acceptance claim.
